note: Hand-drafted dietary statuses for pilot menus that publish no dietary legend and make no whole-menu claim, so tiers 1-3 cannot reach them. Every entry carries a quote that must appear verbatim on the restaurant's live menu; load-drafts.js re-fetches each page and discards any entry whose quote no longer matches. These are proposals. Nothing here publishes without a reviewer.

items.name: Build Your Own Omelet
items.modificationNote: Order with veggies and cheese only. Meat and avocado are separately priced add-ons, so leaving them off keeps the omelet meat-free.
items.evidence: Choose any veggies or cheese $1.25 each, meat or avocado $3.00 each.
items.reasoning: The menu states that fillings are chosen individually and that meat is a separate paid add-on, which is what makes the vegetarian version orderable without guessing at an instruction.

restaurants.name: City, O' City
restaurants.claimEvidence: EVERYTHING is vegan unless you choose dairy mozzarella or egg

items.name: Caesar
items.evidence: Green leaf, caesar dressing, croutons, parmesan
items.reasoning: The menu states 'EVERYTHING is vegan unless you choose dairy mozzarella or egg'. This dish offers neither, so the parmesan and caesar dressing are plant-based by the restaurant's own statement.

restaurants.name: Hudson Hill
restaurants.transcript:
Transcribed by hand from Hudson Hill's PDF menu. The PDF has no usable text layer: its embedded ToUnicode map renders every 'b' as 'i', so machine extraction reads 'Bourion' for 'Bourbon' and 'Blueierries' for 'Blueberries', and most prices cannot be read at all. Only the dietary markers and dish names below were legible enough to transcribe; prices are left as 'See menu' except where the catalog already records one.

MENU KEY
V - Vegan   VG - Vegetarian   GF - Gluten Free

SNACKS
Mixed Organic Olives (V/GF)
Spicy Pickled Okra (V/GF)

TOASTS AND SANDWICHES
Sourdough Toast, Whipped Goat Cheese, lemon zest, and local honey (VG)
La Foglia, Chickpea Salad, Chili Crisp Cucumbers, Arugula (V) 14

BREAKFAST
Noosa Yogurt, Cherry Jam, Fresh Apple, Nuts, Granola (VG)
Grapefruit with Honey (VG/GF)
Toasted Baguette with French Butter and Jam (VG)
Veggie Breakfast Burrito, Eggs, Potato, Cheese, Green Chile (VG)

DELIBERATELY NOT PROPOSED
Granola with Choice of Milk and Blueberries and Nuts (VO) - 'VO' is not defined by this menu's legend, so it is not interpreted.

items.name: Mixed Organic Olives
items.evidence: Mixed Organic Olives (V/GF)
items.reasoning: The menu publishes its own legend, 'V - Vegan', and marks this dish (V). Price not transcribed: the PDF's digits are not legible.

items.name: Spicy Pickled Okra
items.evidence: Spicy Pickled Okra (V/GF)
items.reasoning: Marked (V) against the menu's own legend, 'V - Vegan'. Price not legible in the PDF.

items.name: La Foglia
items.evidence: La Foglia, Chickpea Salad, Chili Crisp Cucumbers, Arugula (V) 14
items.reasoning: Marked (V) against the menu's legend. This is the one dish the catalog already publishes, as 'La Foglia Vegan Sandwich'; the menu itself calls it 'La Foglia', so accepting this draft also corrects the name. The $14 is the one price the corrupted text layer renders unambiguously, and it agrees with the existing audited record.

items.reasoning: Marked (VG) against the menu's own legend, 'VG - Vegetarian'. Goat cheese and honey are consistent with vegetarian rather than vegan.

items.reasoning: Marked (VG) against the menu's own legend. Honey is why the menu marks it vegetarian rather than vegan, and the pipeline does not second-guess that.
